summary: Master ISO 20022 and SWIFT MX messaging. Learn pacs, camt, and pain message mapping, CBPR+ migration, and SWIFT gpi integration. Enroll today.
lede: ISO 20022 training covers structured financial messaging and the operational work involved in moving to MX formats. It is intended for payments operations, treasury systems, connectivity and messaging professionals who handle payment workflows or MT-to-MX transitions. Learners practise validating XML schemas, constructing payment messages such as pain.001, and mapping legacy messages while identifying data truncation risks.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is specifically curated for financial services professionals responsible for the technical and operational transition to structured messaging formats.
modules: ISO 20022 Fundamentals and the MX Ecosystem
XML Schemas and Message Validation Techniques
SWIFT gpi Integration in an MX Context
Compliance and Financial Crime in ISO 20022
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of SWIFT MT messaging (e.g., MT103, MT202) and basic experience in banking operations, payment processing, or financial IT systems. Familiarity with XML concepts is beneficial but not mandatory as core concepts will be reviewed.
